import numpy as np

def controlnet_forward(x, t, text, condition, unet, controlnet, zero_convs):
    # Frozen U-Net features
    unet_features = unet.encoder(x, t, text)
    # ControlNet features from condition
    ctrl_features = controlnet.encoder(condition, t)
    # Add zero convolution outputs
    combined_features = []
    for uf, cf, zc in zip(unet_features, ctrl_features, zero_convs):
        combined_features.append(uf + zc(cf))
    # Run U-Net decoder with combined features
    output = unet.decoder(combined_features, t, text)
    return output
